meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 它会读取你给的目录、网址、粘贴的笔记,或刚做完的这段对话,把其中可复用的步骤整理成一个新的 Claude skill 文件;如果你指定的是已有 skill,它会在原文件上增补更新,而不是覆盖重写。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、“把这个变成 skill”、“把我们刚做的记下来”等关键词,或要求改进某个已有 skill 时触发。它只创建或改进 skill,不安装现成 skill。

say.text: /learn 把这个目录做成一个 skill
say.note: 读取目录内容并新建 SKILL.md

say.text: /learn 把我们刚做的这套流程
say.note: 把本次对话的步骤提炼成 skill

say.text: 更新一下 wow-on-steam-deck 这个 skill
say.note: 在原文件上增补,不整体重写

howto.what_en: It reads a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation, then writes the repeatable steps into a new .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. If you name an existing skill, it updates that file in place.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/learn", "turn this into a skill", "capture this workflow", or a request to update an existing skill. It creates or refines skills; it does not install existing ones.

say_en.text: /learn turn this directory into a skill
say_en.note: Reads the dir, writes a new SKILL.md
Distills this conversation into a skill
Refines the file in place, no rewrite
